correctness.rationale: Bilinear Nijenhuis identity checked on algebra basis; radical-to-scalar part forced zero without characteristic restrictions; T w=lambda w is necessary and sufficient. Counting S w=0 gives the raw total. The algebra automorphism group is GL(V), and a cyclic-module filtration and elimination prove one orbit per distinct eigenvalue-Jordan block size plus zero. Partition weighting and unique factorization give the Euler product. Prime-field direct exhaustive identity and conjugacy tests agree, but the universal claim is mathematical, not experimental.

The known dimension-three complex parameter families, enhanced nilpotent-cone orbit classification, and rational canonical Euler product are explicitly excluded from novelty; the new package couples a field-independent Nijenhuis normal form with a complete marked-eigenvector orbit enumeration and closed generating function. value.rationale: The result settles the natural moduli problem of Nijenhuis structures under algebra automorphisms for every dimension of a canonical class of finite local algebras, including all finite characteristics. It gives full labeled and unlabelled counts, a conceptual eigenmarked matrix classification, and a new explicit comparison with classical matrix similarity Euler series. This is not a single small-field calculation or a special case of known 3D complex operator tables.
